title: SlashZero Demo
provenance: Reported by udance4ever (highball-db#939, 2026-11-03), Apple M1, macOS 27.2, Highball 0.10.24, engine x64-sikarugir10.0_6-r29, D3DMetal, rated 1 of 5 after 1 minutes: the logo shows, then the game's own crash window ('The UE-Zero Game has crashed', Fatal error!) before the title screen. Not verified by the maintainer.
notes: Doesn't start in one report on an M1 with D3DMetal. An Unreal Engine game on DirectX 12, it shows its logo and then a Fatal error crash window.
